headline: Hard to see how Man City recover from extraordinary guilty verdict
description: Tuesday's confirmation that Manchester City were found guilty by the Premier League on over 100 breaches of financial regulations has sent shockwaves through the sport. How do Man City survive this?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: USMNT defender Richards to move to Inter?
description: Crystal Palace and United States defender Chris Richards is reportedly linked with a move to Inter. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man City CEO says Premier League verdict part of 'conspiracy'
description: Manchester City chief executive officer Ferran Soriano has claimed the bombshell guilty verdict against the club is the result of a "Premier League conspiracy theory."

headline: 'The biggest sporting cheating scandal ever' Man City guilty of 114 charges
